name: m9_tidal
_doc: M9 tidal-reversal + ranking-campaign harness (PLAN M9 gate). Runs the live morphodynamic pipeline under a REVERSING tidal current (RESEARCH §8 face-swap reversal through a cosine slack ramp, u*(t) ∝ |U_d(t)|, MORFAC ≤ 5) and, on the same runs, checks: (1) total sand (bed+suspended, CLOSED boundary ⇒ machine precision) conserved < 0.1%; (2) no monotonic kinetic-energy growth across 4 slack transitions; (3) MORFAC |Δz_b| limiter clip-fraction < 1% (research/16). Then ranks 3 candidate shapes (plate/ring/cup) by matched-time trapped volume under the identical tide. Comparative/qualitative — the tool's stated authority (RESEARCH §11); absolute magnitudes inherit the gate_M6 HSV under-prediction. Run: build/Release/scour_m9_gate.exe configs/m9_tidal.json [--quick] [--shapes plate,ring,cup] [--morfac M] [--half-cycles N] [--csv out.csv]; render: python tools/gen_report.py out.csv.
